name: error-pages-03
description: A failure page with a retry button and count, a copyable error ID for support and the technical details folded away.

'use client' import { Disclosure, DisclosureContent, DisclosureTrigger, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/disclosure' import { ErrorPageLayout } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/error-pages' import { CopyButton } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/settings' import { IconPlaceholder } from '@/registry/icons/icon-placeholder' import { formatDate } from '@/registry/lib/dashboardblocks/format' import { type ReactNode, startTransition, useState } from 'react' import { Button, buttonVariants } from '@/components/ui/button' import { CodeBlock, CodeBlockActions, CodeBlockContent, CodeBlockCopyButton, CodeBlockHeader, CodeBlockTitle, } from '@/components/ui/code-block' interface ErrorPages3Props { brand?: ReactNode details?: string errorId: string occurredAt: Date onRetry?: () => void | Promise statusHref?: string supportEmail?: string } const exampleProps: ErrorPages3Props = { brand: ( <> Acme Analytics ), details: 'QueryTimeoutError: warehouse query exceeded 30s (dashboard revenue-overview)', errorId: 'req_7Hq2kX9mP4vB', occurredAt: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 8, 27, 14, 12)), onRetry: () => new Promise((_, reject) => setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Still failing')), 900)), statusHref: '#', supportEmail: 'support@acme.co', } const ErrorPages3 = (props: ErrorPages3Props) => { const { brand, details, errorId, occurredAt, onRetry, statusHref, supportEmail } = props const [retrying, setRetrying] = useState(false) const [attempts, setAttempts] = useState(0) const retry = async () => { setRetrying(true) try { await onRetry?.() } catch { startTransition(() => setAttempts((count) => count + 1)) } finally { startTransition(() => setRetrying(false)) } } return ( Check the status page ) } >
{onRetry && ( )} {supportEmail && ( Contact support )}

{attempts > 0 && !retrying ? `Still not working after ${attempts} ${attempts === 1 ? 'retry' : 'retries'}. Contact support with the error ID below.` : ''}

Error ID
{errorId}
Time
{formatDate(occurredAt, 'time-zone')}
{details && (
Details
Details Error details {details}
)}
) } export { ErrorPages3, exampleProps as errorPages3ExampleProps, type ErrorPages3Props }
